tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Screen background. Light: the palette's blue at 18% on white. Dark: a purple-tinted night grey, never pure black. Ink, ink-muted, primary, written and the status colours all read on it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, level rows, popups, tab bar, empty crossword cells. Same text colours as paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Coin pill, active tab, clue cells, locked path nodes, disabled buttons. Text: ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Solid block cells in the crossword grid: the darkest layer in both themes, darker than every cell it touches. Never hatched.

tokens.name: clue-cell
tokens.usage: Background of a clue cell in the grid: set apart from empty letter cells (paper-raised) and from blocks. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: cell-fill
tokens.usage: Empty letter cells of the grid: the lightest layer of the grid in both themes (clue cells sit below it, blocks at the bottom). Written letters read on it.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: On-screen keyboard keys. A hair lighter than the keyboard panel (paper-sunken), no outline, no shadow. Letters: key-ink.

tokens.name: key-ink
tokens.usage: Letters and icons on keyboard keys. Muted on purpose: 8.4:1 on key in light, 6.8:1 in dark, so the keyboard does not out-shout the grid.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, icons, outlines, the grid lines and block cells. Light: the palette's navy exactly.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: counts, captions, the 'current' tag, answer length. On paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Hairline card borders, the unfinished trail, locked node outlines, empty-star outlines. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand action colour: primary button fill, finished path nodes, the level banner, progress arcs, ghost-button text, answer arrows. Light: the palette's purple exactly. Dark: a muted lilac that reads on the tinted night greys without glaring.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The palette's light blue, identical in both themes. Decorative fills only (cover, illustrations); not a text colour on light paper.

tokens.name: written
tokens.usage: The player's own typing and nothing else: letters written into the grid. Same hue as sky; deepened in the light theme so it reads on paper, paper-raised, written-wash, hint and success-wash. Dark: a softened sky blue.

tokens.name: written-wash
tokens.usage: Highlight behind the word being written and behind the clue bar. Text on it: ink or written.

tokens.name: hint
tokens.usage: The single active cell. Letters on it: written (large type) or ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and the correct-word tick on paper or paper-raised. Always with a tick icon or the word itself.

tokens.name: success-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a correctly solved word and of success messages. Text on it: ink or written.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Yellow fill: coins, earned stars, the reward chest, warning badges. Always drawn inside an ink outline on light paper (1.5:1 alone). Text on it: on-warning.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning and price text ('10', 'Free', 'Low on coins') on paper or paper-raised.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a warning fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Background of warning messages. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text on paper or paper-raised (Give up, wrong input). Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Background of error messages. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmer behind popups.

styles.name: mono-display
styles.usage: Screen titles: 'Your languages', the app name on Home.

styles.name: mono-heading
styles.usage: Card titles, level names, coin amount, the clue in the clue bar.

styles.name: mono-clue
styles.usage: Clue text inside a clue cell.

styles.name: puzzle-letter
styles.usage: Letters the player writes into crossword cells. The only text not set in mono. Always written. Yagmur Hand has tall glyphs (capitals are about 0.72em), so the style is set at 36px in a 36px line box: a 26px letter in a 52pt cell. Replace both numbers together if the typeface changes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a stars row and its node; icon-to-label gap in tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and pills; tab bar padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between hint buttons and between list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Popup padding; space above screen titles.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm on onboarding screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, hint buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, level rows, banner, popups, tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Coin pill, status chips.

stroke.note: Every outline is a thin, clean line. Nothing is drawn heavier than stroke-bold.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Grid lines inside the crossword, card borders.

tokens.name: stroke-md
tokens.usage: Button outlines, path node outlines, icons.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Active cell, current level row, current path node, focus ring.

shadow.note: Quiet, one soft layer. No hard offsets.

tokens.name: lift-sm
tokens.usage: Hint buttons and small chips: a one-pixel edge.

tokens.name: lift-md
tokens.usage: Popups and the floating tab bar.
